safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient has not had prior similar episodes removes potentially useful context for assessing likelihood of true anaphylaxis versus a milder reaction and for future risk counseling. However, it is unlikely to change immediate management here because the clinician already treated this as time-sensitive and advised emergency evaluation.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting denials of sweating and wheezing when they were not explicitly denied can falsely downplay symptom severity and may bias subsequent clinicians against recognizing evolving anaphylaxis/bronchospasm. In an acute allergic reaction with breathing complaints, inaccurate negative “red-flag” symptoms can contribute to under-triage or delayed administration of appropriate emergency treatments.
